questNames: The cells are open. The prisoners show you the transport route.
questVerdict: The captives’ chains are broken. The grave warden guards the passage to the shore.
questBell: The prisoners aboard the ship are free. The bell no longer commands them.
questMemory: The dark shipment is halted. The road to the ruins is revealed.
questKing: The victims’ bonds are broken. The voices inside the stone fall silent.
questEcho: The cavern passage is open. You found the road to the forge.
questPrisoner: The forge prisoners are free. They will no longer feed the fire.
questHeart: You control the final gate mechanism. Head for the court.
ruinsIntro: This is what the Qadi calls salvation. His victims cannot die. The earth holds them bound.
ruinsCheckpoint: The stone is safe. Head for the cavern’s final passage.
ruinsBoss: The Sacrifice Warden guards the Qadi’s road. Break through.
ruinsWin: The warden has fallen. Heat rises from the forge beneath the cavern.
forgeIntro: The guards’ weapons and the prisoners’ chains are forged here. You have reached the Qadi’s furnace.
forgeCheckpoint: Catch your breath away from the embers. The forge master holds the final gate.
forgeBoss: The Forge Master approaches. This time he faces his own iron.
forgeWin: The forge is silent. No more chains will be made. The road to the Final Court is open.
coastIntro: This port trades in people. The Qadi’s ships bring prisoners here.
coastRoots: Roots coil around the victims buried on the shore. The earth will not let them go.
coastStreet: The houses were emptied. Marks on the doors count the prisoners.
coastPier: The lanterns guide the slave ships. There are living people inside.
coastSquare: Nameless graves lie beneath the square. The port master knows the numbers, not the names.
coastCheckpoint: Catch your breath beside the lantern. The road to the belfry is clear.
coastBoss: The port master calls his hunters with the bell. Silence it.
coastDeath: The sea did not take you. Return to shore and rise.
coastDeath2: The roots could not hold you. Walk again.
coastDeath3: The bell still tolls. You will not remain on this shore.
coastSeal: The transport route is opening. Head inland.
coastWin: The bell is silent. The prisoners’ transport has stopped. The road to the Qadi runs through the ruins.
intro: They buried you alive, Bahtiyar. You broke the stone lid. Break the prisoners’ chains and leave this grave.
chains: Living prisoners remain at the ends of these chains. Open the cells.
ritual: The wounded were never brought here to heal. Their suffering feeds the Qadi’s ritual.
crypt: The altar is still warm. This grave is the first stop for the sacrifices.
rot: Bones are built into the walls. The Qadi will not release even his dead.
checkpoint: Catch your breath beside the stone. Your road is not over.
boss: The Grave Warden holds the passage. The road to the port lies behind him.
heroOath: You buried me. Now it is your turn.
cellat: The Qadi wants you alive. You will return to your coffin.
seal: Another chain is broken. Keep moving.
death: You are still breathing. Get up.
death2: This grave cannot hold you. Try again.
death3: You broke the stone lid. Do not give up here.
win: The warden has fallen. The road to the slave port is open.
